title: A Deployment the API server rejects
prompt: A teammate adapted this Deployment from a blog post. `kubectl apply` fails, and after fixing the first error it fails again with a different one. Select the **two** lines to fix.
hints: Which API group and version do Deployments use in current Kubernetes?
Compare the selector's labels with the labels the Pod template sets, character by character.
explanation:
Line 1 uses `extensions/v1beta1`, which was removed long ago; apply fails with `no matches for kind "Deployment"`. Use `apps/v1`.

Line 13 labels the Pods `notes`, but the selector asks for `notes-api`, so the API server rejects the Deployment because its selector doesn't match its own template. Make them identical:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
# …
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: notes-api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: notes-api
```
